{#- Header language switcher: a compact native
/ dropdown. The closed state shows only the current language code (a small fixed footprint that cannot overflow the header at any viewport width); opening reveals every language with the current one marked, in an absolutely-positioned panel that overlays content instead of stretching the header. Dependency-free and licence-clean: native HTML disclosure, no required script, no external asset; styling lives with the header family in _static/cadrumo-docs.css using Furo's CSS variables so light and dark both render (cadrumo-docs.js adds optional outside-click / Escape dismissal as progressive enhancement). The element itself is built in dev/docs/language_switcher.py and handed to every page through html_context. It is the one piece of chrome that varies three ways at once between language roots -- span against link, one directory level of depth, and the current language's own code -- with the page's own path in the middle, which is more than a template can carry in one value for every language at once (see dev/docs/compile_slots.py). -#} {%- if cadrumo_language_switcher -%}{{ cadrumo_language_switcher }}{%- endif -%}
